Winnie Odinga has opened up about the pain of grieving her father, Raila Amolo Odinga, saying grief doesn’t come with a handbook. In an emotional post, she admitted that there are times when people are expected to smile while carrying pain that no one can see, lead before they’ve had the chance to heal, and stay strong even as they try to make sense of what has happened.

Winnie said her journey is not just about loss but also about resilience. She added that if sharing her story reminds even one person that healing is not linear, then it was worth opening up about her experience. #winnieodinga

₿ Bitcoin Weekly Outlook

Bitcoin begins the week in a fragile recovery phase.

After slipping below $60,000 in the latest pullback, BTC has climbed back into the low-$60,000s, but conviction remains uncertain.

This week's key driver isn’t hype. It’s liquidity.

ETF flows, Fed expectations, the dollar, and risk appetite will likely decide whether Bitcoin can keep its recovery on track or face renewed selling pressure.

What to watch this week:

➡️ If BTC stays above $60,000, confidence could gradually return and buyers may push toward the next resistance.

➡️ If it breaks above $63,000–$64,000, the rebound could gain momentum and shorts may come under pressure.

➡️ If BTC slips back below $60,000, fear could return quickly as traders eye another move toward recent lows.

Right now, Bitcoin hasn’t confirmed a bullish reversal, but it isn’t dead either.

This looks like a market weighing whether the recent drop was a reset or the start of more volatility.

This week, patience matters more than emotion.
